questions.question: The Gibeonites told Joshua they had come from a very distant land. What reason did they give for coming?

answers.text: Because of the fame of the LORD
Because a famine drove them out
Because enemies chased them from home

questions.question: Before making a treaty with the disguised Gibeonites, what did Israel's men fail to do?

answers.text: Seek the counsel of the LORD
Send scouts to the envoys' homeland
Demand a payment from the envoys

questions.question: After learning the Gibeonites had tricked them, why did Israel not attack the Gibeonite cities?

answers.text: The leaders swore an oath to them by the LORD
The Gibeonite armies were far too strong
The Gibeonites paid Israel to leave them alone
